name: Modal
title: One trustworthy graph behind every GTM decision
subtitle: People · Organizations · Workspaces · Revenue
focus: Resolve who is using the platform, connect the evidence to an account and reconcile the commercial numbers before activation.
priorities: Build the people / organization / workspace graph.
Model reliable GTM data in Snowflake and dbt.
Activate clean data through reverse ETL and CRM workflows.
Reconcile actuals, forecasts and credited attainment.
layers: Workspace, usage, billing and CRM identifiers with event times.
Person affiliations and company domains with confidence and conflict history.
Account usage, commercial status and actual / forecast / credit definitions.
Approved account context to CRM; unresolved identities stay in review.
rules: A personal email is evidence of a user, not proof of a company.
Keep affiliation history; do not overwrite a previous employer on an ambiguous match.
Actual revenue, forecast value and credited attainment remain separate measures.

personas.name: ML infrastructure lead
personas.pain: Workload growth without shared operational context
personas.promise: A workload-aware conversation that keeps technical constraints attached.
personas.subject: Scaling {{workload}} with the team
personas.email: Hi {{first_name}}, the next useful conversation starts with your workload: its pattern, constraints and ownership. What changes when your team moves from individual experiments to a shared production service?
personas.question: Which workload is recurring, and who owns reliability and spend?

personas.name: Revenue operations
personas.pain: Conflicting identities and inconsistent commercial measures
personas.promise: One traceable organization graph and clearly separated actual, forecast and credit models.
personas.subject: One organization, several workspaces
personas.email: Hi {{first_name}}, a company can appear as several workspaces, billing accounts and CRM records. I’d start by agreeing on the organization grain and the evidence for each match. Where do identity differences currently affect a GTM decision?
personas.question: What is the authoritative source for actuals, forecast and credited attainment?

pitch: I combine enterprise sales experience with practical data-system building. Hey Sammy required explicit record structure, deduplication, validation and resumable collection; my local CRM preserves contact provenance and pipeline state. At Modal, I would bring that attention to identity and evidence to the people, organizations and workspaces behind GTM decisions.
mappings: Hey Sammy: structured records, validation, deduplication and resumable jobs.
Start with explicit entity keys and source-aware tests.
Local partnership CRM: deduplicated imports and contact provenance.
Review people / workspace affiliations before an account update.
Accounting degree and enterprise sales / partnership experience.
Make actuals, forecast and credit definitions understandable to the team.
northStar: Verified organization context that GTM can trust
weekOne: An explainable identity-review queue for a bounded workspace cohort.
days60: Extend the organization graph and model freshness to a second data source; activate approved fields with traceable receipts.
days90: Reconcile actuals, forecasts and credited attainment with Finance and RevOps, then improve the next expansion signal.

competitors.name: Baseten
competitors.context: Provides production inference infrastructure and managed or self-hosted deployment options.

competitors.name: Amazon SageMaker AI
competitors.context: AWS machine-learning platform covering model building, training and deployment.
competitors.question: Which existing AWS commitments, operational requirements and developer workflows constrain the evaluation? Benchmark the actual workload rather than claiming a universal cost advantage.

firstBuilds.title: Organization graph review queue
firstBuilds.goal: Make a match explainable before using it to target an account.
firstBuilds.scope: A bounded sample of workspace and CRM records.
firstBuilds.measure: Match precision, unresolved affiliations, duplicate accounts and review time.

firstBuilds.title: Account usage model
firstBuilds.goal: Give GTM teams context without losing the underlying workspace grain.
firstBuilds.scope: One production-use signal and one reverse-ETL destination.
firstBuilds.measure: Freshness, accepted updates and seller usefulness.

firstBuilds.title: Commercial reconciliation
firstBuilds.goal: Explain the bridge from billing to forecast to seller credit.
firstBuilds.scope: A finance / RevOps-reviewed period and a small account cohort.
firstBuilds.measure: Unexplained variance, late-arriving events and ownership exceptions.

projectRelevance.sammy: Discovery, structured extraction and geospatial validation demonstrate a disciplined approach to identity, data grain and exceptions.
projectRelevance.sidequest: Deduplicated CRM imports and provenance are directly relevant to clean account activation and seller context.
projectRelevance.dancers: Signed webhooks, retry-safe notifications and recovery illustrate the reliability patterns needed around commercial events.
